planned.subtitle: {hall} · section in development
section.events.decisions.f1: Potential and allow conditions with the `AND`/`OR`/`NOT` builder.
section.events.decisions.f2: Preview with the 95×95 picture and the texts.
section.events.decisions.f3: The default picture is the one named after the decision.
section.events.decisions.intro: Decisions (`decisions/*.txt`) with their picture, conditions and effects, edited as readable sentences.
section.events.modifiers.f1: Effects with their type and value.
section.interface.images.f1: The five variants of each flag as 93×64 TGA.
section.interface.images.intro: Event and decision pictures and country flags.
section.interface.sprites.f1: Import an image as uncompressed DDS and register it.
section.interface.sprites.f2: Textures also resolved with the alternative extension (`.tga`/`.dds`).
section.interface.sprites.intro: The sprites in `interface/*.gfx`: find them, view them and add your own.
section.interface.windows.f1: Move, resize and align elements on a canvas.
section.interface.windows.f3: “Duplicate as variant” without breaking the original window.
section.interface.windows.intro: The game windows (`interface/*.gui`) drawn as in the game, to modify them or duplicate them as a variant.
section.localisation.all.intro: Every text the game will show, from the base game and the mod, in one editable table (unsaved changes included)
section.localisation.csv.subtitle: The mod's localisation CSV files as they are on disk, read-only: texts are edited in All texts
section.localisation.pending.intro: The mod's texts still missing in the project's languages
section.map.climates.f1: Continent and climate map modes, with their legend.
section.map.climates.f2: Each continent's and climate's modifiers in a form.
section.map.climates.intro: Continents (`continent.txt`) and climates (`climate.txt`, with its paired keys) assigned per province.
section.map.forge.f1: Relief, rivers, climates and biomes, and the split into provinces, states and continents.
section.map.forge.f3: Export of all consistent files in a single transaction.
section.map.forge.f4: Audit of everything that depends on the map: histories, POPs, regions…
section.map.forge.intro: A workshop that generates a new map procedurally, in the style of Azgaar's Fantasy Map Generator, or imports it from your bitmaps, with all its dependent files.
section.map.regions.f1: Create, rename and merge states by painting provinces on the map.
section.map.regions.f2: Warnings for provinces with no state or in two states at once.
section.map.regions.f3: State names in Spanish and English, kept in sync with localisation.
section.map.regions.intro: States (`region.txt`) and sea regions (`region_sea.txt`) on the map, with their invariants: every land province in exactly one state and no sea province in any.
section.map.straits.f1: Draw a strait by joining two provinces and the sea province it crosses.
section.map.straits.f2: Canals with the technology that opens them.
section.map.straits.intro: Straits and canals from `adjacencies.csv`: the crossings between provinces that do not touch on the map.
section.nations.cultures.f1: First and last names with a list editor that checks Windows-1252.
section.nations.cultures.f2: Group, colour, graphical unit type and union.
section.nations.cultures.f3: The culture's texts in Spanish and English.
section.nations.cultures.intro: Culture groups and cultures from `common/cultures.txt`: create a new culture and give it names, colour and units.
section.nations.governments.f1: Allowed ideologies, elections (`election`, `duration`) and party appointment.
section.nations.governments.intro: Forms of government from `common/governments.txt`, with the ideologies they allow and their elections.
section.war.bookmarks.f1: Name, description, date and camera of each start date.
section.war.bookmarks.f2: `start_date` and `end_date` without losing the formatting of `defines.lua`.
section.war.bookmarks.intro: The game's start dates (`common/bookmarks.txt`) and the date limits in `defines.lua`.
section.war.cb.f1: Duration, cost, infamy and peace effects (`po_*`).
section.war.cb.f3: Icon picked from the game's own, and texts in Spanish and English.
section.war.cb.intro: Casus belli from `common/cb_types.txt`: create a new one or edit the base game ones.
section.war.diplomacy.f1: One table per kind of relation, with its dates.
section.war.diplomacy.f2: Warnings for relations with countries that do not exist.
section.war.diplomacy.intro: Alliances, vassals, unions and guarantees when the game starts (`history/diplomacy/`).
section.war.land.f1: Cost, upkeep and combat stats compared with the base unit.
section.war.land.f2: Activation with `activate_unit` in technologies and inventions.
section.war.land.intro: Land units from `units/*.txt`: duplicate a base game one and adjust its stats.
section.war.naval.intro: Naval units from `units/*.txt`, with the same editor as land units.
section.war.wars.f2: War goals with their casus belli, actor and receiver.
section.war.wars.f3: Dated history of who joins and who leaves each side.
section.war.wars.intro: Wars active when the game starts (`history/wars/`), with their sides and goals.
